notes: Shopify storefront (serax.com). Checked main nav, mega-menu, footer, /pages listing (no 'new arrivals'/'new in'/'what's new' page), and the full sitemap.xml -> sitemap_collections_1/2.xml + /collections.json (3137 unique collections, exhaustively paged). Direct probes of /collections/new-arrivals, /new-in, /newin, /just-in, /latest-arrivals all 404. Used the site's own /search/suggest.json?q=... for 'new arrivals' (zero collections/pages/articles/products), 'new in' (zero collections matching the concept -- the only collection hit was handle 'new', site title literally '[HIDDEN] new', published 2025-07-25, part of the same reg-*/[hidden] cluster of ~30 auto-generated gift-registry list collections found across the full collection sweep [e.g. 'registry new', 'new house', 'new list', 'Jeremy's nieuwe plek'] -- these are Shopify gift-registry app artifacts, not a merchandising New Arrivals PLP, and are explicitly marked hidden by the site's own naming convention, so excluded), and local-language equivalents 'nieuw'/'nieuwste' (NL) and 'nouveautes'/'nouveau' (FR) -- no genuine New Arrivals-type collection surfaced by any of these. No 'New Collection'/'New Season'/'New Range' style page exists either (checked /pages list -- only designer bio pages, policy pages, and a shop-all-products page, none framed as new arrivals). Concluded, after real investigation across nav + sitemap + site search in English and local languages, that Serax does not currently expose a genuine New Arrivals-type merchandising PLP.
